steps.harmonic: Most minor music raises the seventh note a half step, so it leans into the home note as in a major scale: the harmonic minor. The raised note isn’t in the key signature; it’s written as an accidental every time. {a} minor raises {g} to {gSharp}, {e} minor raises {d} to {dSharp}, and {d} minor raises {c} to {cSharp}.
steps.aHarmonic: {a} harmonic minor, with {gSharp} near the top.
steps.dHarmonic: {d} harmonic minor, with {cSharp}: a sharp in a key with a flat.
steps.dHarmonicLeft: {d} harmonic minor with the left hand.
